Because the oasis stamp is verified against the lagoon nonce, the quartz audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 12 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 78 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
